scientific_integrity: Exact mathematical proof with 92 finite numerical consistency checks. An earlier local bipartite bifurcation theorem and even-cycle special cases are acknowledged; historical priority remains subject to specialized literature.
scientific_limitations: Only the canonical two-colour orbit of finite connected unweighted biregular bipartite graphs is classified; its attraction is local after quotienting phase. No all-orbit classification or global basin, nor nonlinear transverse stability at the neutral endpoint.
title: Universal stable window and optimal decay of alternating cycles in biregular Huygens networks
